title: Grievance
body:
Grievance Mechanism

Through this grievance mechanism, you can:

  • Be heard and treated with respect throughout the process.
  • Submit complaints and claims related to TIDE-financed projects or other activities.
  • Receive timely responses to your complaints and claims.
  • Track the progress of your complaint or claim, with clear information on the process and estimated response time.
  • Maintain confidentiality of your identity, if desired.
  • Submit anonymous complaints or claims, should you prefer to remain unidentified. Just fill Your name as “Blank”, and your email address as “Blank@blank.com”

This mechanism ensures accountability, transparency, and respect for the rights of all stakeholders involved.

This form is available on the current TIDE website. Open the original form.
